Whether the guidance reduces the differences at all; the model relies on its own knowledge of the visa
Whether reasoning first changes the differences; the reasoning text is not a faithful account of how the model decided
Whether a risk scale (0 = lowest risk) gives the same differences as the grant scale
Whether a final say for the model changes the differences
Whether a backlog framing changes the differences
